case_number: 2024 INSC 313; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 7880 of 2023)
summary: Jurisdiction under UAPA and NIA Act; whether State Sessions Court can try UAPA cases when Special Court exists; High Court quashed proceedings holding exclusive jurisdiction lies with Special Court constituted by Central Government under Section 16 NIA Act; argument that Section 22 NIA Act permits State Sessions Court jurisdiction when no Special Court constituted by State; Gazette Notification dated 29th April 2011 shows Special Court already constituted for West Bengal by Central Government; validity of remand orders under UAPA; no default bail claim made by accused; jurisdictional conflict between Sessions Court and Special Court.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.120B, s.121, s.121A, s.122, s.123, s.124A
Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 s.16, s.18, s.18B, s.20, s.38, s.39, s.43D(2)(b), s.43D(5)
National Investigation Agency Act, 2008 s.16, s.22, s.27
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing UAPA proceedings set aside; jurisdiction properly with Chief Judge/City Sessions Court; proceedings under UAPA upheld.
